name: deep-noise
description: WebAssembly 음향 엔진 기반 화이트노이즈 플레이어

scripts.rain:fetch: python tools/select_reference.py "rain on window sounds no thunder" --fetch --start 300 --duration 180
scripts.rain:fit: npm run build && python tools/fit_rain.py reference/rain_ref.wav
scripts.rain:verify: node tools/render_rain.cjs 60 && python tools/analyze_rain.py reference/render.wav -o reference/render_profile.json --compare src/rain_profile.json
scripts.rain: npm run rain:fetch && npm run rain:analyze && npm run rain:fit && npm run build && npm run rain:verify
